newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's City Telecom IPO 2.85 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's City Telecom IPO 2.85 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Telecommunication services provider City Telecom (HK) Ltd said on Monday its initial public offer (IPO) of shares was oversubscribed 2.85 times.
The company offered 100 million new shares at HK$1.80 each in Hong Kong. A preferential offer of 10 million shares to the company's employees was also fully subscribed, it said.
"The response from the investors has been satisfactory and reflects their interest in the company," City Telecom chairman Ricky Wong said.
"We will use the proceeds to upgrade the group's telecommunications network and to spendon research and development of new services," he said.
City Telecom will raise net proceeds of HK$165 million after expenses. Dealing in the shares will commence on August 4.
